label: Fires at D1 late in episode after a1 led rarely to S2, strongest after two such trials.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state - prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial > 60) ;; (phase == D1) * (ep_trial > 70) * (prev_state - prev_action + tv("state", -2) - tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state - prev_action == 1) * (ep_trial > 80)
terms: (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("action", -3) == 1) * (tv("state", -3) == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (ep_trial > 60) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (ep_trial > 75) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("action", -1) == 1) * (tv("state", -1) == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (ep_trial > 60)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.8% of steps), only active at D1. Its magnitude is driven by the previous trial having been an a1 choice that landed in S2 (a rare transition), regardless of reward (unrewarded slightly higher), and only late in the episode (trial > ~60, growing toward the end). The biggest factor is two consecutive a1->S2 trials: after a single a1->S2 it is weak (~0.2-0.5), after two in a row it saturates near 1.2. a2 choices, S1 outcomes and GO/D2 steps give ~0. Belief log-odds added little beyond trial history. The short form (prev a1->S2 late; two consecutive a1->S2 later; extra late boost) matches the 8-term free fit (dev 0.43 vs 0.43), well above the profile's additive 'all' ceiling of 0.12, because the effect is a conjunction of history and episode time. Remaining error: windows whose earlier history is cut off (first trial of the window fires at full strength with no visible preceding a1->S2) and a few non-consecutive a1->S2 repeats.

issues: The claims check out. The short form reproduces on test (R^2 beyond timing 0.425; 0.431 on dev). In the timing profile every GO and D2 cell is +0, so 'only at D1' holds. The D1 residuals are +0.094 after a1 S2 u and +0.059 after a1 S2 r, against about -0.012 for every other previous-trial pattern, so 'a1->S2 rewarded or not, unrewarded slightly higher' holds too.

The two-in-a-row term carries most of the fit. On its own, (phase==D1)*(ep_trial>70)*[two back-to-back a1->S2] scores test 0.335. A single a1->S2 term with ep_trial>60 scores only 0.191. Making ep_trial graded instead of thresholded does worse (0.165 for the single term, 0.255 for the pair term), so the thresholds are a fair description and not overfitting.

The third term (a1->S2 * ep_trial>80) is partly a fitted correction for the late-episode growth, but it matches the stated 'grows toward the end'. Moving the thresholds around (60/65/70/80/85) changes test R^2 by only about 0.02.

Not fully captured: a single a1->S2 trial sometimes fires at full strength (misses example: t77 at 1.16 after one a1->S2 whose D1 was 0). In a free fit, a non-consecutive a1->S2 three trials back adds +0.03 test R^2 (0.453 vs 0.425), so 'two in a row' is a simplification of a longer accumulation of rare a1->S2 trials. The rest of the misses are windows whose relevant history falls before the window starts; the explanation already acknowledges both.

Misses show no large systematic class. The mean error by phase is at most 0.006, and the worst (phase, previous trial) cells are D1 after a1 S2 u (+0.012) and D1 after a1 S2 r (-0.020), which matches the small reward effect the short form leaves out. Adding belief_lo or belief_cover adds less than 0.01, and adding the previous trial's reward adds about 0.008.
